name: What are common signs of a gas line leak?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a gas line leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a gas line leak include a distinct sulfur-like odor, often described as rotten eggs. You might also hear a hissing or whistling sound near a gas line, see discolored vegetation near outdoor gas lines, or notice a sudden increase in your gas bill without increased usage. If you suspect a leak, evacuate the area immediately and contact your gas provider and a licensed plumber like CG Plumbing Solutions to assess the situation safely. Delaying action can increase risks, so prompt reporting is crucial.
